items.context:
#Drawtober2026 Day 24: Nostalgia I was super young when I played Demon's Crest on my parent's SNES. I didn't understand the password system, so I played the first hour of the game who knows how many times, and I remember thinking Firebrand was the coolest character
image: Fanart of Firebrand from the video game Demon's Crest Firebrand is a red gargoyle with a sharp beak-like mouth, an elongated head, long ears, and glowing yello…
items.text: Demon's Crest was a tough one to get into as a kid, and that password screen got a lot of us. Firebrand is a great character, lovely drawing.

items.author: toestubian.bsky.social
items.context: I've dabbled with a few and have a retro repack of a few old ones in one game on epic. I'm very open to recommendations!!
items.text: If you want to try more, GOG packages many classics so they run on modern PCs without fiddling, and they're DRM-free. Fallout and Heroes of Might and Magic III are easy places to start.
